cross_ref_S2_P3: G-S7P3-01 (refund) overlaps with S2-P3 G-S2P3-01 — DELIBERATELY attested twice from different angles (S2-P3 = POS component-side gap, S7-P3 = RBAC + permission ring-fence angle). G-S7P3-02 (customer history visible to cashier) overlaps with S2-P3 G-S2P3-04 — same gap, here re-attested as a Spatie permission denial layer rather than a missing embedded panel. G-S7P3-04 (phone search) is NEW (not in S2-P3). G-S7P3-03 (incident note) is RELATED to S2-P3 G-S2P3-05 (internal_note on order) but DIFFERENT scope — incident-note is order-INDEPENDENT (a daily journal), order-internal-note is order-SCOPED.
verdict: 5 owner-implicit gaps verified from admin/RBAC/cashier-shoes angle. P0 BLOCKER: refund UI button + Spatie permission ring-fence (G-S7P3-01 + G-S7P3-06 paired). P1 daily-pain: phone-search absent (G-S7P3-04) + customer-history RBAC-gated (G-S7P3-02) + incident-note infrastructure missing (G-S7P3-03). P2 nice-to-haves: cashier-scoped today summary chip (G-S7P3-05), global cmd-k search (G-S7P3-07), better cashier landing page (G-S7P3-08). The POS Operator role is currently HARDENED to only 7 permissions — defensible from NF525/RGPD posture but creates two real daily blockers: (a) no refund self-service, (b) no repeat-customer recognition. Recommend V1 patch wave shipping G-S7P3-01 + G-S7P3-04 + G-S7P3-02 (narrow `customers_orders_read` mint) before V1 cutover. G-S7P3-03 and G-S7P3-05 are V1.0.X candidates. Total: 5 owner-implicit + 3 bonus = 8 gaps documented, all backend infrastructure largely ready, no frozen-zone touch required.
